records.localization_note: Hodram Bergstrom is the ordinary nameplate. The distinct CF role-zero selector remains dynamic in the priest scene.
Janus Pasar keeps the approved name while he discusses the telescope and doubts its attribution.
Julio Erneco worries about Cristina as her grandfather. Hodram's respectful address does not extend that relationship to himself.
Yukihisa Shiraki speaks in his formal register when explaining the clan and when asking to see Muramasa.
Emilio Ferog retains the regular-font F in his nameplate. His enthusiasm carries the tomato, banana and Hestia's Pot exchanges.
Angelo Puccini is the crewmate who brings the nukenin rumor. Mamma mia remains his own exclamation.
Gerhard Adernkatz remembers the sword he lost and follows up on what the priest says about the Proof.
Charles Rochefort explains the amber with his usual scientific curiosity. The port worker's confusion stays his own reaction.
Fernando Dias retains the registered ordinary F. His spoken objections and his stat notices refer to the same person.
Samwell Khan is the short header for the crewmate who brings the two animal-themed rumors. The full catalogue component is separately inherited.
Trader is the source shop role. Giving the seedling does not establish a different occupation.
Port Worker identifies the man who mentions the island off the cape.
Priest is the source role. His explanation and blessing name no separate person or rank.
Sailor is the familiar voice who asks whether the captain believes in miracles.
Margrete is the established nameplate for the speaker who points the crew toward the priest.
